title: Loops Continued
objectives: Master break and continue for loop control
Use advanced range() with custom steps
Apply common loop patterns (accumulator, counter, flag)
Solve real-world problems like prime checking and FizzBuzz
description: Master advanced loop control with break, continue, and custom range() patterns. Learn loop optimization and common patterns used by professional developers. Build FizzBuzz and prime checkers!

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Break Statement
exercises.description: Use break to exit a loop early.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Continue Statement
exercises.description: Use continue to skip an iteration.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Range Step
exercises.description: Use range with a custom step.

exercises.title: Glitch Fix: Wrong Loop Type
exercises.description: Using while when for would be better! Convert to for loop.

exercises.title: Glitch Fix: Range Bounds
exercises.description: Should print 10-20 but prints 10-19! Fix the stop value.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Suspect Scanner
exercises.description: Loop through the suspects list ['Neo', 'Trinity', 'Morpheus', 'Agent Smith'] and print each one.

exercises.title: Field Mission: FizzBuzz
exercises.description: Print numbers 1-15. If divisible by 3: 'Fizz', by 5: 'Buzz', by both: 'FizzBuzz', else: the number.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Find Target
exercises.description: Search numbers 1-100 for the first one divisible by 7. Print it and stop.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Countdown Sequence
exercises.description: Missile defense system needs a 5-stage countdown. Type the loop that counts stages 0-4 before launch authorization.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Infiltration Route Calculator
exercises.description: You're planning a stealth infiltration. Each step advances you deeper into enemy territory. Type the professional code that calculates total distance penetrated using the accumulator pattern.
exercises.targetCode:
# Calculate total distance
total = 0
for step in range(10):
    total += step  # Add each step
print('Total distance:', total)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Jammed Broadcast Signal
exercises.description: MAYDAY! Your emergency beacon is stuck broadcasting forever, draining battery. It should only send 5 distress signals. Fix the range before power failure!

exercises.title: Cryptography: Permutation Key Generator
exercises.description: Your encryption requires calculating possible key permutations. Use factorial (5! = 5×4×3×2×1 = 120) to determine how many ways the enemy can try to crack it. Every permutation matters!
exercises.starterCode:
# Calculate encryption permutations: 5!
result = 1
for i in range(1, 6):
    # Multiply for permutations
exercises.solution:
result = 1
for i in range(1, 6):
    result *= i
print(result)

exercises.title: Laser Security: Breach Visualization
exercises.description: Hacking enemy security grid. Each * represents a breached laser beam. Print the penetration pattern showing 4 progressive breach levels (1 beam, 2 beams, 3 beams, 4 beams).
exercises.solution:
for i in range(1, 5):
    print('*' * i)

exercises.title: Black Market: Transaction Tracker
exercises.description: You're buying intelligence from multiple sources. Prices: $10, $25, $5, $15, $30. Loop through each payment and calculate the total cost of your intel network.
exercises.starterCode:
# Calculate total intel acquisition cost
prices = [10, 25, 5, 15, 30]
total = 0
exercises.solution:
prices = [10, 25, 5, 15, 30]
total = 0
for price in prices:
    total += price
print(total)

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Surveillance Pattern Decoder
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Enemy patrol uses coded intervals (1-20). Divisible by 3 = 'Fizz' (guard change), by 5 = 'Buzz' (camera sweep), both = 'FizzBuzz' (full alert). Decode their 20-minute security cycle to find infiltration windows!
